item.title: 2 arrested after dressing as construction workers to try to enter the US, CBP says
item.description: Two people were arrested after they attempted to unlawfully enter the United States by dressing up as construction workers and blending in with other workers, Customs and Border Protection said.The two people were arrested just west of the Paso del Norte International Port of Entry on Jan. 9.Officials said one of the arrested had a previous criminal record of domestic assault and would be prosecuted under reentry of a removed alien. item.title: Judge orders release of 5-year-old, father from Texas ICE facility
item.description: A federal judge has ordered the release of a 5-year-old boy and his father from a Texas detention facility days after blocking their deportation.In a scathing court order Saturday, Judge Fred Biery ordered the release of Liam Conejo Ramos and his father, Adrian Conejo Arias, from an Immigration and Customs Enforcement detention facility in Dilley, Texas, no later than Tuesday.Conejo Ramos and his father were detained in Minnesota last week after arriving home from school. item.title: Deadline to apply for SNAP replacement benefits extended in Texas
item.description: Gov. Greg Abbott announced Friday that the state received federal approval to push the deadline back so people who lost food in the storm can still feed their families.

item.title: TABC finalizes new rules for Texas hemp industry
item.description: New rules for the hemp industry have been finalized by the Texas Alcohol and Beer Commission, replacing emergency rules that went into place last September.

item.title: 50 community parks across Texas to be improved after record-setting grant disbursement
item.description: Fifty community parks are set to be improved across Texas, gaining nature trails, native landscaping, playgrounds, splash pads, sports fields, kayak launches, piers and other park amenities.
